thread:
anya: bringing kokoro21b (21B, int4) up on canary. seeing intermittent OOMs when the request has >384 max_new_tokens and prefetch is enabled. logs point to kv allocation spikes. anyone seen this pattern?

mike: hmm, similar spike with another 21b yesterday. looked like large prefix + prefetch window caused kvcache growth then eviction thrash. did you capture the OOM backtrace?

sarah: paste of the relevant log snippet from the canary node:```
[2025-11-09T14:12:03Z] OOM: failed allocate 81920 bytes at kv_storage.cpp:412
stack: kv::alloc -> kv::ensure_prefetch_window -> runtime::handle_request -> model::generate
mem_used=63.1GB mem_limit=64GB kv_pages=982 prefetch_pages=48
```

jen: :thinking: sounds like we're hitting slot fragmentation, not just raw usage. prefetch_pages=48 seems high for a single request. what's the batch size/prefetch chunk config?

anya: defaults on canary: batch_size cap=8, prefetch_chunk=16, kv_page_size=64k. reproducer is a streaming chat with long system prompt + user history ~6k tokens then asking for 512 new tokens.

mike: two short experiments to try: lower max_new_tokens default to 256 for kokoro on canary; and try soft-evict (reduce prefetch target when free pages < X). that reduces OOM but may add p99 latency.

jen: agree. propose a temporary per-model override in rollout:```json
{"model":"kokoro21b","defaults":{"max_new_tokens":256,"prefetch_chunk":8,"batch_cap":6}}
```
apply to 10% canary. monitor p99 latency and kv_pages.

anya: ran quick bisect: disabling prefetch removes OOM but p99 increases ~150ms. disabling only prefetch for long-gen requests (max_new_tokens>384) removes OOM while keeping short gens fast.

mike: ok actionable: (1) add per-model rule to lower max_new_tokens default to 256 for kokoro; (2) add conditional prefetch guard: skip prefetch if requested max_new_tokens > 384 OR estimated new_kv_pages > 24; (3) add metric kv_page_churn to alert if >20% within 5m.

sarah: i'll add a short benchmark to compare quality vs latency for 256 vs 512 generations (sanity QA and rouge/qa F1), to ensure no regressions from lowering default. i'll run locally w/ same seed set and share diffs.

jules: i can run the rollout changes and the canary config. tagging @jen for console UI change to show per-model defaults in the model page so support can explain behavior.

ci-bot: canary config patch submitted: PR #4207 — kokoro21b per-model defaults + conditional prefetch guard. CI passed, ready to deploy to 10%.

anya: thanks — assigning follow-ups: jules (deploy & smoke), sarah (quality bench), mike (pager rule + kv_page_churn alert), jen (console copy). will reconvene in ~2 hours for initial canary metrics. :thumbsup:
